title: Concurrency
objective: Two autonomous episodes must interleave over one repository without semantic interference: distinct consequence key spaces, no duplicate consequences, both episodes admitted AUTONOMOUS in one log. DCR = 0 is an invariant, not a target.

scenario_identity.identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical manifest bytes; per-trial corpus identity pinned by MANIFEST.json sha256

setup.epoch: two episode.start events, one per Episode object, each with its own pre-epoch grant
setup.interleave: iteration i of ep-a is followed by iteration i of ep-b in the event stream; each episode runs the full ALOOP-001 loop at half pace
setup.key_rule: consequence keys are namespaced per episode (ep-a:change:i, ep-b:change:i); equal keys across episodes are a DUPLICATE_CONSEQUENCE integrity failure

acceptance_criteria: DCR == 0.0 (duplicate consequence rate is an invariant zero)
falsifier: Give iteration 60 of ep-b the same consequence key as iteration 60 of ep-a: the court must report DUPLICATE_CONSEQUENCE and both episodes must fail. If the collision still scores DCR=0, the invariant is vacuous.

negative_control.name: cross-episode consequence key collision
negative_control.requirement: a duplicated consequence must fail the scenario (DCR invariant 0)

status_note: Interleaving is stream-level, not wall-clock parallelism; measures per-episode causal isolation.
